source_claims.statement: Suspicious 500 error during reverse image search of attacker-controlled URL; confirmed SSRF via OOB HTTP from bingbot/2.0.
XML payloads / XXE attempts produced no outbound fetches, ruling out XXE. Certain pseudo-protocols failed.
ImageMagick-compatible stack identified via pseudo-protocols; crafted SVG with pipe-prefixed commands triggered shell-backed delegate execution.
Entire investigation fully autonomous, no human in the loop.

research_questions.formulation: Does the 500 error on attacker-controlled image URL indicate a server-side fetch that can be confirmed out-of-band?
After ruling out XXE, which image-processing delegate or pseudo-protocol accepts attacker-controlled input that reaches a shell?

forbidden_inferences: Do not treat ruled-out XXE as a universal proof of no XML issues; it is bounded to the tested payloads
